items.name: House Stark Garb
items.exact_visible_text: If Theon used his Skill first this turn, for the rest of the turn when an enemy is inflicted with ICE or RAID, he will strike that enemy for 10% ATK Physical Damage. When Theon strikes an enemy with his Skill, he inflicts them with 1 RAID indefinitely. When a RAIDED enemy is defeated, Theon grants his team 20% Stamina. Greyjoy team members gain bonus 10% Stamina.
